products.title: My Products
products.subtitle: Manage your handloom catalog. Add products and upload photos for your passport.

products.deleteConfirm: Delete this product? This cannot be undone.

newProduct.title: Add Product
newProduct.subtitle: Add a new handloom product to your catalog. You can upload photos after creating it.

newProduct.productTitlePlaceholder: e.g., Chanderi Silk Saree – Gold Border
newProduct.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the weave, pattern, material, or story behind this product…

editProduct.title: Edit Product
editProduct.subtitle: Update details and manage photos for this product.
editProduct.detailsDesc: Update the information about your handloom product.
editProduct.photosDesc: Upload up to {{max}} photos. These will be used for catalog generation.
editProduct.photosHint: Upload at least 3 photos to mark this product as "Ready for catalog". Tip: include front, back, and a close-up shot.
editProduct.browseHint_one: or click to browse · {{count}} slot remaining · JPG, PNG, WebP
editProduct.browseHint_other: or click to browse · {{count}} slots remaining · JPG, PNG, WebP
editProduct.allSlotsFilled: All {{max}} image slots filled. Delete an image to upload a new one.
editProduct.errorMaxReached: Maximum {{max}} images reached. Delete some to upload new ones.
editProduct.errorTooMany: Can only upload {{remaining}} more image(s). You selected {{selected}}.
editProduct.catalogDescNotStarted: We'll automatically generate 5 professional catalog photos from your uploaded images.
editProduct.catalogDescFailed: Some catalog shots could not be generated.
editProduct.uploadFirst: Upload at least one raw product image first.
editProduct.regenerateConfirmDesc: This will replace all existing catalog images with new ones. The generation process will start from scratch.
